This '''admiral''' commanded the [[Oplovis Sector Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was [[Battle in the Yuvern system|defeated]] by the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] in the [[Yuvern system/Legends|Yuvern system]], the admiral was "[[Death/Legends|retired]]" by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].
